notes.title: 📢 Psychopathy Assessment is OUT NOW on Steam! 📢
notes.content:
[h2]Prepare to question your sanity and face the unknown with the Psychopathy Assessment! [/h2]

🎉 Immerse yourself in an analog horror experience from the 1980s, where reality and hallucination blend. [i][b]Do you have what it takes to pass the high-stakes psychopathy test? [/b][/i]

[i]Once your assessment is completed, you'll be plunged deeper into the twisted world of a psychopath.[/i]

[url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/video-games/3835718/lo-fi-ps1-styled-analog-horror-game-psychopathy-assessment-arrives-this-halloween-trailer/][img]https://i.imgur.com/gzocVvQ.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.flickeringmyth.com/ps1-style-horror-psychopathy-assessment-blurs-the-lines-between-reality/][img]https://i.imgur.com/XgVSzVZ.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.infobae.com/malditos-nerds/2024/10/17/psychopathy-assessment-presenta-terror-psicologico-con-graficos-de-la-playstation-original/][img]https://i.imgur.com/3thTi07.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Features: [/h3]
[list]
[*] 🔪 Unique Gameplay - Engage in a tense psychopathy test that determines if you're a psychopath, followed by PS1-style gameplay surprises.

[*] 🎥 VHS Horror Aesthetic - Classic visuals, VHS filters, and a chilling atmosphere capture the haunting essence of analog horror.

[*] 🧩 Psychological Immersion - Test your limits as you face unsettling questions, uncover your darkest thoughts, and witness the story unravel.
[/list]

Your choices and actions will reveal your true nature… if you dare to discover it.

[h3][b]🔗 Grab Psychopathy Assessment on Steam now! Test your psyche, unravel the story, and find out if you’re really ready to face your inner demons.[/b][/h3]

[h3]Thank you for your support and enjoy the experience. We look forward to hearing your feedback and seeing how you survive Psychopathy Assessment![/h3]
